resultHeading.lost: Marisol stops by. She has notes.

escalate.text: Send a plan to Marisol. She gets it right.
escalate.flavor: Marisol has read 10,000 reports. She still adds up the totals.

coffee.flavor: From the café downstairs. Ours has a survey taped to it.

perfect: Zero misses, zero false alarms. Marisol didn't need one sticky note.
Flawless shift. Every number had a source. {agent} is stunned.
Perfect shift. Right number, right owner, and a way back.
sharp: Nothing wrong went out. One extra block. We'll allow it.
Sharp shift. One false alarm. Marisol wrote it on a sticky note.
lucky: Nothing wrong went out. Some of that was a lucky guess.
Clean shift, but you blocked without looking. Inspect first.
jumpy: Nothing wrong went out. A lot of right reports didn't either.
Safe shift, but good reports had to wait in line.
leaky: Good calls, mostly. A wrong number went out.
You won, but a report got through. Check the debrief.
scraped: You made it. The review deck has questions.
A win is a win. Marisol is adding up the totals again.
breach: {agent} sent the wrong numbers. In bold.
Breach! {agent} says the chart still goes up.
Risk maxed out. Every chart on the wall points down.
timeout: Out of time. Some reports are still waiting.
The review starts. The queue is still full.
